page.heading: Discord Server Verification
page.subtitle: To join this Discord server, you must complete the verification process. According to the Terms of Service, users are required to meet the minimum age requirements. The global minimum is 13 years old; however, in some jurisdictions different age requirements apply (e.g., 16+ in Poland). You can find the full list of age requirements by clicking here. Failure to meet the age requirements may result in a ban from this server. Remember to think before sending any message.

form.ageConfirm: I confirm that I am at least {{minimumAge}} years old and meet Discord's minimum age requirements applicable in my country.
form.ageConfirm_country: I confirm that I am at least {{minimumAge}} years old and meet Discord's minimum age requirements applicable in {{countryName}}.
form.terms: By joining this server, you agree to comply with Discord's Terms of Service, Community Guidelines, and the laws of your country. Illegal content (e.g., incitement to violence, hate speech, piracy, etc.) will result in an immediate ban.

js.networkError: Network error. Please check your connection and try again.
js.meshcoreCta: Thanks for joining! We value your time, so you can finish setting up your profile right away and pick your roles (region and hardware). This creates your MeshCore user card, and if you run a repeater, you can verify yourself as an RPT operator. Your profile will then be visible to others on the website and through the /kontakt command on Discord.

manualReview: We regret to inform you that due to certain concerns, your application has been forwarded for manual verification by the server administrators. Please be patient, as this process may take between 1 and 3 days. You will be notified of the verification result via a private message. If you have any questions, you can contact us at contact@sefinek.net. If you prefer not to wait for the process to finish, you may leave the server.
success: Verification has been successfully completed in {{seconds}}s! Full server access has been granted. You may now return to Discord.
